import type { TTSContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class TTS extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        summary: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        state: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        iconOnly: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
    };
    summary: string;
    state: TTSContract['state'];
    size: string;
    iconOnly: boolean;
    constructor();
    private request;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
